key.name: workspace-layout-orientation
key.summary: The order workspaces fill the grid in
key.description: With "horizontal" the workspaces fill each row from the left, starting with the top row. With "vertical" they fill each column from the top, starting with the left column.

key.name: workspaces-per-output
key.summary: Each monitor has its own workspaces
key.description: When true, each monitor has its own active workspace, and switching the workspace of one leaves the others as they are. Every monitor has the same number of workspaces, with the same names in the same grid. When false, switching the workspace switches every monitor, as Marco does.

key.name: workspace-slide
key.summary: Slide the windows when the workspace changes
key.description: When true, a change of workspace shows the old workspace's windows leaving and the new one's arriving, the way the two are in the workspace grid. When false, the change is a cut, as in Marco. The slide also needs compositing-manager on and reduced-resources off in org.mate.Marco.general, and enable-animations on in org.mate.interface.

key.name: overview-animation
key.description: When true, the Overview opens and closes with each window moving between its place and its place in the Overview. When false, it opens and closes at once. The transition also needs compositing-manager on and reduced-resources off in org.mate.Marco.general, and enable-animations on in org.mate.interface.

key.name: open-close-animation
key.description: When true, a window that opens grows into its place and fades in. When false, it is there at once, as in Marco. The animation also needs compositing-manager on and reduced-resources off in org.mate.Marco.general, and enable-animations on in org.mate.interface.

key.name: maximize-animation
key.summary: Animate windows as they are maximised
key.description: When true, a window that is maximised or unmaximised moves and grows into its new place while a picture of it as it was fades out. When false, it is there at once, as in Marco. The animation also needs compositing-manager on and reduced-resources off in org.mate.Marco.general, and enable-animations on in org.mate.interface.

key.name: popup-slide
key.summary: Slide menus and other popups as they open
key.description: When true, a menu, a tooltip or another popup that opens slides out of what it is attached to. When false, it is there at once, as in Marco. The slide also needs compositing-manager on and reduced-resources off in org.mate.Marco.general, and enable-animations on in org.mate.interface.

key.name: overview
key.description: The shortcut that opens the Overview, which shows the windows of the workspace side by side, and closes it again. It is a key or a mouse button with its modifiers, written as the keys of org.mate.Marco.global-keybindings are: "<Super>w", or "<Super>Button9". With "disabled" or the empty string, nothing opens the Overview.

key.name: application-overview
key.description: The shortcut that opens the Application overview, which shows the windows of the focused window's application side by side, and closes it again. While the Overview is open it shows the application's windows alone, and the Overview's shortcut shows every window again. It is written as the overview key is. With "disabled" or the empty string, nothing opens the Application overview.

key.name: hot-corner-top-left
key.summary: What the top left corner of a monitor does
key.description: What happens when the pointer rests in the top left corner of a monitor, where it can go no further either way: "overview" opens the Overview on that monitor, or closes it, "application-overview" opens the Overview of the focused window's application on that monitor, or closes it, "show-desktop" shows the desktop, or stops, and "lock" locks the session. With "none" the corner does nothing.

key.name: hot-corner-top-right
key.summary: What the top right corner of a monitor does
key.description: What happens when the pointer rests in the top right corner of a monitor, where it can go no further either way: "overview" opens the Overview on that monitor, or closes it, "application-overview" opens the Overview of the focused window's application on that monitor, or closes it, "show-desktop" shows the desktop, or stops, and "lock" locks the session. With "none" the corner does nothing.

key.name: hot-corner-bottom-left
key.summary: What the bottom left corner of a monitor does
key.description: What happens when the pointer rests in the bottom left corner of a monitor, where it can go no further either way: "overview" opens the Overview on that monitor, or closes it, "application-overview" opens the Overview of the focused window's application on that monitor, or closes it, "show-desktop" shows the desktop, or stops, and "lock" locks the session. With "none" the corner does nothing.

key.name: hot-corner-bottom-right
key.summary: What the bottom right corner of a monitor does
key.description: What happens when the pointer rests in the bottom right corner of a monitor, where it can go no further either way: "overview" opens the Overview on that monitor, or closes it, "application-overview" opens the Overview of the focused window's application on that monitor, or closes it, "show-desktop" shows the desktop, or stops, and "lock" locks the session. With "none" the corner does nothing.

key.name: hot-corner-activation-delay
key.summary: How long the pointer rests in a corner before it acts
key.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the pointer rests in a corner of a monitor before the corner does what its hot-corner key sets, the same for all four corners. With 0 a corner acts as soon as the pointer reaches it. Once a corner has acted, it acts again only after the pointer has left it and 350 milliseconds have passed.

key.name: key-remaps
key.description: Combinations Caminito swaps for others, or for nothing, before the focused window's application gets them. Each entry is a Remap group: its name, its application ids, whether it has no remaps at all, and its remaps, each a combination such as "Alt+T" and the steps it is sent as, such as ["Ctrl+T"], or none for nothing. The first group is All applications, with the name "" and no application ids; a group's remap replaces All applications' for the same combination. A combination is modifiers among Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Super, and a key by its keysym's name, joined by "+". A System shortcut is never remapped.

key.name: key-remap-template
key.description: The name of the Remap template the Key remaps were last loaded from or saved as, or "" if none.

key.name: workspace-layout-rows
key.description: The number of rows in the workspace grid. 0 derives it from the number of columns and the number of workspaces. If the rows and the columns are both 0, the workspaces are in one row.

key.name: workspace-layout-columns
key.description: The number of columns in the workspace grid. 0 derives it from the number of rows and the number of workspaces. If the rows and the columns are both set and the grid is too small for the workspaces, a horizontal grid gets more columns and a vertical one more rows.

key.name: locker-command
key.description: The program that draws the lock screen and unlocks the session, and its arguments, run without a shell. Any locker that speaks ext-session-lock works, such as ['swaylock'], as long as it doesn't fork into the background. The session stays locked whatever the locker does: one that exits is started again, and after five failed starts within a minute the screen says how to unlock from a text console.

key.name: night-light-enabled
key.description: Whether every output is warmed toward a lower colour temperature, on the schedule "night-light-schedule" names.

key.name: night-light-schedule
key.description: With "sun" the temperature follows the sun's elevation where the user is: "night-light-night-temperature" while the sun is below the horizon's civil twilight, rising to "night-light-noon-temperature" at the day's highest. With "constant" it's "night-light-constant-temperature" all the time.

key.name: night-light-noon-temperature
key.description: The colour temperature, in kelvin, that the sun schedule reaches when the sun is at its highest. 6500 is neutral.

key.name: night-light-night-temperature
key.description: The colour temperature, in kelvin, that the sun schedule holds while the sun is more than 6 degrees below the horizon.

key.name: night-light-constant-temperature
key.description: The colour temperature, in kelvin, that the constant schedule holds.

key.name: night-light-paused-until
key.description: The Unix time until which Night Light is paused, and the outputs are neutral. 0 is not paused. Pausing sets it to the next sunrise, and turning Night Light on or off sets it to 0.

key.name: night-light-last-location
key.description: The latitude and longitude, in degrees, that geoclue last gave Caminito, which the sun schedule follows while geoclue gives none. Caminito writes it.

key.name: same-on-all-outputs
key.summary: Whether every output has the same wallpaper
key.description: While it's on, every output shows the wallpaper at /org/mate/caminito/wallpaper/all/. While it's off, each monitor shows its own, at /org/mate/caminito/wallpaper/outputs/ and its identity.

key.name: outputs
key.description: The identity of each monitor caminito-wallpaperd has drawn on, as its keys' path has it. A monitor not listed is new, and starts with the primary output's wallpaper. caminito-wallpaperd writes it.

key.name: pictures
key.description: The picture files added in the Wallpaper dialog, which it lists beside MATE's and Plasma's.

key.name: folders
key.description: The folders added in the Wallpaper dialog, whose pictures it lists beside MATE's and Plasma's.

key.name: dynamics
key.summary: The dynamic wallpapers the user added
key.description: The timed XML and HEIC files added in the Wallpaper dialog, which it lists beside the ones under /usr/share/backgrounds and /usr/share/wallpapers.

key.name: took-mate-background
key.description: Whether caminito-wallpaperd has made the picture org.mate.background names every output's wallpaper, which it does on its first run alone. caminito-wallpaperd writes it.

key.name: kind
key.description: What the output shows: "picture", the file "picture" names, or "colour", the colour "colour" names, or "slideshow", the pictures of the folder "slideshow" names, or "dynamic", the dynamic wallpaper "dynamic" names, or "picture-of-the-day", today's picture from the source "picture-of-the-day" names.

key.name: picture
key.description: The picture file a "picture" wallpaper shows. With none, or one that can't be read, the output shows its colour.

key.name: dynamic
key.description: What a "dynamic" wallpaper shows: the folder of a Plasma package with light and dark pictures, which follow the sun, a GNOME timed XML file, which follows the clock, or an Apple HEIC file, which follows the sun or the clock as its metadata says and is shown with libheif's heif-dec. With none, or one that can't be read, the output shows its colour.

key.name: slideshow
key.description: The folder whose pictures a "slideshow" wallpaper shows one after another, its own and not its folders'. Pictures added to it or taken from it are picked up. With none, or a folder that's empty or missing, the output shows its colour.

key.name: slideshow-interval
key.summary: How long each of the slideshow's pictures shows
key.description: The slideshow changes at each whole interval of the local clock: every 5 minutes, 15 minutes or hour from midnight, or at midnight for "day".

key.name: slideshow-in-order
key.summary: Whether the slideshow goes by name
key.description: Whether the slideshow shows its pictures in the order of their names rather than at random. At random, every picture shows once before any shows again. Either way, each output on the same folder shows a different picture while the folder has enough.

key.name: picture-of-the-day
key.summary: The source of the picture of the day
key.description: Where a "picture-of-the-day" wallpaper's picture comes from: "apod", NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day, "bing", Bing's, or "commons", Wikimedia Commons'. caminito-wallpaperd fetches it at the session's start, on a wake from suspend and after midnight, and keeps the latest of each source under ~/.cache/caminito-wallpaper. Until the first is fetched the output shows its colour.

key.name: positioning
key.summary: How the picture fits the output
key.description: "fill" covers the output and crops the picture, "fit" shows all of it with bars of the colour, "stretch" scales it to the output's shape, "centre" shows it at its own size in the middle, and "tile" repeats it at its own size from the top left.

key.name: colour
key.description: The colour, as #rrggbb, that a "colour" wallpaper shows, and that shows where a picture doesn't cover the output.

key.name: delivery
key.description: What a notification gets: "bubble", a Notification bubble and a place in the Notification history, "history", a place in the history only, or "off", nothing at all.

key.name: sound
key.description: Whether a new notification plays its sound, or the sound theme's for a notification. Off, no notification plays one. A notification that asks for no sound never plays one.

key.name: previews
key.description: Whether a Notification bubble shows the notification's summary, body and image. Off, it shows only its app and "Notification". The Notification center always shows the whole notification.

key.name: app-icon
key.summary: Whether bubbles show their app's icon
key.description: Whether a Notification bubble shows its app's icon beside the app's name. The image follows previews alone.

key.name: group
key.summary: Whether an app's notifications are grouped
key.description: Whether a Notifying app's notifications share a grouped Notification bubble and one group in the Notification center. Off, each stands alone in both.

key.name: badge
key.summary: Whether an app's Dock item shows its Badge
key.description: Whether the Dock's item of a Notifying app shows the number of the app's notifications in the Notification history, when the program sets no count of its own.

key.name: breaks-through
key.summary: Whether an app's notifications break through Do Not Disturb
key.description: Whether a Notifying app's notifications get their bubble and their sound while Do Not Disturb is on.

key.name: corner
key.description: The corner of the output under the pointer where the Notification bubbles show, the newest nearest it, under the panel.

key.name: timeout
key.description: The seconds a Notification bubble stays when its app leaves that to the daemon. A critical notification's bubble stays until the user closes it.

key.name: critical-breaks-through
key.summary: Whether critical notifications break through Do Not Disturb
key.description: Whether a critical notification, such as a dying battery's, gets its bubble and its sound while Do Not Disturb is on.

key.name: do-not-disturb-schedule
key.summary: Whether Do Not Disturb has a daily schedule
key.description: Whether Do Not Disturb comes on every day from do-not-disturb-from to do-not-disturb-to.

key.name: do-not-disturb-from
key.description: The minute of the day, from midnight in local time, when the daily schedule turns Do Not Disturb on. 1320 is 22:00.

key.name: do-not-disturb-to
key.description: The minute of the day, from midnight in local time, when the daily schedule turns Do Not Disturb off. Before do-not-disturb-from, it's the next day's. 420 is 07:00.

key.name: do-not-disturb-while-fullscreen
key.summary: Whether Do Not Disturb is on while a window is fullscreen
key.description: Whether Do Not Disturb is on while the output under the pointer has a fullscreen window, as Caminito tells.

key.name: do-not-disturb-while-screencasting
key.summary: Whether Do Not Disturb is on while the screen is shared or recorded
key.description: Whether Do Not Disturb is on while a screencast runs, as Caminito tells: while any capture of the screen is open, a screenshot's included.

key.name: known-apps
key.description: The key of each Notifying app the daemon knows: its desktop entry's id without ".desktop", or the name it gives when it has none. caminito-notifications adds an app as it sends its first notification.

key.name: delivery
key.description: What the app's notifications get: "bubble", a Notification bubble and a place in the Notification history, "history", a place in the history only, with no bubble and no sound, or "off", nothing at all.

key.name: sound
key.summary: Whether the app's notifications play a sound
key.description: Whether a new notification of the app plays its sound. None plays while org.mate.sound's event-sounds is off.

key.name: previews
key.summary: Whether the app's bubbles show their notification
key.description: Whether the app's Notification bubbles show the notification's summary, body and image.

key.name: app-icon
key.summary: Whether the app's bubbles show its icon
key.description: Whether the app's Notification bubbles show its icon beside its name.

key.name: group
key.summary: Whether the app's notifications are grouped
key.description: Whether the app's notifications share a grouped Notification bubble and one group in the Notification center.

key.name: badge
key.summary: Whether the app's Dock item shows its Badge
key.description: Whether the app's Dock item shows the number of its notifications in the Notification history.

key.name: breaks-through
key.summary: Whether the app's notifications break through Do Not Disturb
key.description: Whether the app's notifications get their bubble and their sound while Do Not Disturb is on.
